title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Doctor, can I borrow half of your desk? Thank you very much. Huff... Ah, it's a blueprint for a new electrical system. I need to get it drawn up by today. Are you busy too? Let's be partners in overtime, then?

title: Talk 1
original: I've been into electricity ever since I was a kid. Just listening to currents crackling really soothed me. Huh? You think that's weird?

title: Talk 2
original: You learn a lot when you're in Rhodes Island's Engineering Department. The Operators bring weapons and equipment from all over, all sorts of technological applications you've never seen before, and all of them worth plenty of research time. If I put more efforts to my work, I might be able to stay in the Engineering Department.

title: Talk 3
original: This is 'Pillow,' a childhood friend of mine. Our family moved from somewhere way far all the way to Columbia, and I found myself very lonely at school. My mom gave me Pillow to keep me company. Oh, Doctor, you should know it can't speak!

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I got into an accident while I was on a lone study out in the country, and was unable to contact the rescue team. Pillow and I had to make it all the way back to inhabited land on foot. After that... I didn't really want to go out doors.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: My dreams... that I work well, and everyday is a nice day. Also, I want to buy a holiday villa in Sami, and after my parents are retired, they can live there together... yeah, I've gotta stay healthy, and keep on trucking until they retire.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Since I was little, my mom and dad would find time every year to take me to the tundras on vacation. We're all really into cold places! Although if I wanted to cover the cost for my own vacations, I'd have to go pick up work in the city again.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Haah, *yawn*... Sorry, Doctor, can I take a break here for a little bit...? Ever since this new project kicked off, the shift schedule's been completely crazy! I still have to go check over the base station later...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: To tell the truth, I've wanted to try going outdoors lately. I've gotten to know a lot of people in the same line as me at Rhodes Island, and I wanna experience more along with them. At least... I'm not ever going to be stuck on my own again, not now.

title: Idle
original: Oh, the Doctor's asleep…? Well, I'd better turn this machine down a bit. It's kind of loud…

title: Onboard
original: Hello, I'm an electrical engineer from Columbia, codename... Well, Closure suddenly started calling me 'Pudding', but I don't know if that's too weird...

title: Watching Battle Record
original: So this is how professionals fight… Alright, I'd better put in some training if I'm gonna make it through this safely.

title: Promotion 1
original: Thank you for the recognition. I still have a ways to go compared to Rhodes Island's other Operators, so if there's any more high-effort work, throw it my way. If I just get enough sleep, I can hold out for some real long shifts.

title: Promotion 2
original: Combat missions in the tundra? At this point, I think I can be of help. Doctor, thank you, and all of Rhodes Island for always encouraging me. I'd like to pitch in some of my own strength now.

title: Added to Squad
original: I'm being assigned to combat? Just give me a bit more time to get ready... I... I can do this.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: I don't have much confidence in commanding, but I do know a thing or two about basic survival in the countryside.

title: Depart
original: Pillow, don't you go leaving my sight.

title: Begin Operation
original: Getting shocked hurts, you know?

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Yep... understood.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Phew—Pillow, let's do our best!

title: Deployment 1
original: Waaaah, careful!

title: Deployment 2
original: Alright, I... I'm up!

title: In Battle 1
original: Collector on standby!

title: In Battle 2
original: Electric diffusion!

title: In Battle 3
original: Electric charge!

title: In Battle 4
original: Live discharge!

title: 4-star Result
original: Mission complete. Right now, I got the same feeling I get seeing a blueprint come perfectly to life. What a relief!

title: 3-star Result
original: That wasn't too bad of a job... heheh, can you put this in my evaluation?

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Ugh... no. A discrepancy like this should be totally avoidable.

title: Operation Failure
original: Everyone, orderly retreat, please! I don't want anyone to fall behind!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Phew, now where should I put Pillow...

title: Tap
original: Oh, careful, you'll get shocked!

title: Trust Tap
original: Ahh... please don't throw out any of the pink household goods in the Engineering Department. Those are for overtime use!

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Doctor, Happy New Year! Heheh, I'm going to take a few days off at a mountain resort nearby. There's a towering ski slope there, and hot springs, and ice fishing! Alright, see you la— The electrics need maintenance? Ohh... okay...

title: Greeting
original: Good morning, Doctor. *yawn*... I should probably catch up on some sleep.

title: Birthday
original: Doctor, happy birthday! Here's a doll for you, it looks just like my Pillow. Isn't it cute? It... It looks kind of like me? No it doesn't!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Closure says she has a surprise for everyone today. Soo… I hope you'll like the light show tonight, Doctor. Actually, the energy-saving proposal for the string lights was mine, which I worked a whole week of overtime on to... no, never mind...
